visualCharacteristics: One Dynamic Media image or video in a <figure>, centred in the content column
Images render as a responsive picture (webp source plus jpg/png fallback at 750/1200/2000px, quality 85) with a sizes attribute
Videos render inline in a 16:9 ink frame (AEM Assets player iframe or the browser's video player), never autoplaying
Optional caption under the media: small slate text
An unrecognised URL, or an image that fails to load, shows as a plain link instead of a broken image
Same layout options as image: wide, full, narrow, left, right (float beside text on desktop), rounded
contentPattern: URL row (required): a Dynamic Media URL as a link or plain text (optionally labelled URL | ...)
Optional labelled two-cell rows in any order: Alt | text, Caption | text, Crop | name or $preset$, Ratio | 16:9 or 1600x900, Type | video
Unlabelled single-cell rows after the URL: alt text, then caption; a row starting with $ or : is the crop / preset
Supported URLs: Dynamic Media with OpenAPI delivery (delivery-pXXXX-eYYYY.adobeaemcloud.com/adobe/assets/urn:aaid:aem:...), Scene7 /is/image/ and /is/content/ (video), any .mp4 or Brightcove link
usage: Ad-hoc content updates in Document Authoring: place an AEM Assets (Dynamic Media with OpenAPI, environment p7954-e2285674) or classic Scene7 image or video on any page by pasting its URL.
reuseGuidance: Use when the asset lives in AEM Assets / Dynamic Media and should be delivered (and cropped) by Dynamic Media. For an image uploaded into the DA document use image; for a poster that turns into a player on click use video.
